new.s: According to the Tendulkar methodology, what was India's poverty ratio in 2009-10?
new.x: Under the Tendulkar line, all-India poverty was 29.8% in 2009-10 (rural 33.8%, urban 20.9%); it fell to 21.9% in 2011-12.
new.angle: U0475 notes gap: Tendulkar 2009-10 all-India 29.8%

new.s: Which State had the lowest poverty ratio in India in 2011-12 under the Tendulkar method?

new.angle: U0475 notes gap: lowest Tendulkar ratio Goa

new.s: Between 2011-12 and 2022-23, urban poverty in which State fell from 50.8% to 9.1%?

new.s: Under the Rangarajan line (RBI update, 2022-23), which State had the lowest rural poverty?

new.s: Corrado Gini, who proposed the Gini coefficient in 1912, was a statistician from which country?

new.s: What is the situation in which unemployment benefits discourage people from taking up work called?

new.s:
Consider the following statements about unemployment on usual status basis:
